# uuid 1.26.1 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/uuid (2026-09-10)
- docs: https://docs.rs/uuid/1.26.1/uuid/
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0

```toml
uuid = { version = "1.26.1", features = ["v4"] }
```

`Uuid::new_v4()` for `Idempotency-Key` when `send` has no `--key`. Hyphenated form matches Worker `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$`. Printed to stderr as `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` only (never tokens).
